settings.pause: The shop only runs while you're playing: it pauses when you switch tabs or close the game, and stays open until you press Close shop.
prep.kitchen: Morning suggestions cover the wait for your kitchen’s first batches. Ingredients include later batches without counting the morning bake twice.
prep.capacity: The kitchen may not keep up with this menu. Bake more in the morning, serve fewer baked dishes, or hire another cook.
prep.partial: Budget {money}: only part of the forecast can be purchased.
prep.noPurchase: No ingredients purchased. Check the remaining budget.
day.discard: Unserved orders and unfinished kitchen batches will be discarded. Ingredients already used still count as costs. Guests whose accepted orders are cancelled will leave a one-star review.
day.closeHelp: Stop arrivals and finish accepted orders before settling.
report.doorLost: Could not join the full queue
report.shortSample: Under 1 minute: too short to compare profit rates reliably.
report.adviceStock: Orders encountered missing stock. Check ingredients and the morning bake before opening again.
report.adviceDelivery: Guests left while waiting at tables. Check production and the pass; extra servers help when finished orders are piling up.
report.adviceCounter: The queue could not keep up. Compare faster dishes, the machine and baristas before attracting more guests.
report.adviceBake: There were baked leftovers. A smaller morning batch may fit a short visit better.
report.adviceGood: Service ran without recorded stock or waiting losses. Compare menu margins before your next investment.
ops.workRemaining: At least {n}s of station work, plus walking
ops.closing.detail: The door is closed. Accepted orders and started batches are finishing; no new batches start. You can speed up, or settle now to discard unfinished work.
ops.ingredients.detail: An available menu item cannot be made. Buy the missing ingredients in the Pantry. More staff will not solve an ingredient shortage.
ops.delivery.detail: Orders are waiting on the pass. Servers, rather than faster brewing, can clear finished plates. Farther rooms also take longer to reach.
ops.baking.detail: A cook is making this dish. A larger morning batch can bridge the wait; fewer baked dishes or more cooks can ease a busy kitchen.
ops.shelf.detail: This dish has run out. With a kitchen, a free cook will replenish it when ingredients are available. Without one, plan more in the morning or build the kitchen while closed.
ops.counter.detail: Guests are queuing while baristas work. Compare faster dishes, a machine upgrade and another barista. More arrivals can make this queue longer.
ops.quiet.detail: The counter and delivery staff are currently idle and stock is available. The Chalkboard Sign attracts more guests; watch again before buying more production capacity.
ops.steady.detail: No sustained bottleneck detected. Watch actual sales, stock and the closing report before changing your setup.
area.serviceDistance: Extra seats and arrivals also increase delivery work. Watch the pass before hiring.
rating.title: Customer reviews
rating.empty: Your first review arrives when a guest finishes their visit.
rating.effect: Reviews change arrivals only, never prices, tips or payment per order. Four stars means normal traffic; the effect ranges from −25% to +25%.
rating.smoothing: The first 20 reviews are smoothed toward four stars so one bad visit has limited impact. After that, the latest 50 count; better service replaces old reviews.
rating.rules: Taste sets the base: standard 4.0, practiced 4.5, signature 5.0. Combos average the dishes actually delivered. The final score is the lower of taste and the service cap, rounded to one decimal. In game time from arrival to handoff, the cap is 5/4/3 stars within 12/25/40 seconds, or 2 for longer waits. A missing add-on caps the score at 3. A sold-out main, table walkout or cancelled accepted order earns 1; a queue walkout earns 2.
rating.fairness: Each guest reviews once. People turned away by a full queue and queued guests sent home at closing leave no review.
rating.noReviews: No new reviews this session. Your reputation is unchanged.
rating.reason.verySlow: The order took far too long
rating.reason.soldOut: The main order was sold out
rating.reason.queueWait: Gave up after a long queue
rating.reason.tableWait: Left before the order reached the table

taste.label: Taste {score} · {tier}
taste.title: {item} · Recipe research
taste.standard: Standard: 4.0 taste as soon as the dish is unlocked.
taste.skilled: Practiced: after 30 delivered portions, future portions have 4.5 taste.
taste.signature: Signature: deliver 100 portions, then research while closed to reach 5.0 taste.
taste.rules: Only portions handed to guests count toward practice. Baking, waste and cancelled orders do not count. Price upgrades do not improve taste.
taste.costRule: Research is a one-time investment: 20× the base price, at least $150. It improves taste without changing prices, tips or preparation speed.
taste.researched: {item} is now a signature recipe with 5.0 taste!
taste.block.owned: This dish has reached its highest taste level.

rating.reason.signatureTaste: Excellent signature flavor — worth coming back for
